integrity: The averaging identities and conjugation formulas are rederived directly from the multiplication table. Finite exact checks are used only as regression tests; the classification and uniqueness are proved symbolically.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only the complex pre-Lie algebra with \(e_1\cdot e_1=e_2\); it does not classify averaging-operator orbits on the other two-dimensional pre-Lie algebras or in positive characteristic.
title: Automorphism normal forms for averaging operators on the nilpotent two-dimensional pre-Lie algebra
